name: Supergiant Games
description: Founded in 2009, Supergiant Games is an independent studio based in San Francisco that's committed to making meaningful, memorable video games built on time-honored traditions and new ideas. Best known for its Greek mythology-inspired dungeon crawler Hades, Supergiant recently launched its first-ever sequel in Hades II.

name: The Behemoth
description: San Diego local indie developer The Behemoth will once again be attending the Triton Gaming Expo! We're so excited to show you what we've been working on, and we hope you'll stop by and say BAAAAWK!

name: Brace Yourself Games
description: Award-winning indie developer creating innovative rhythm-based games.

name: Giant Squid
description: Known for crafting breathtaking, emotional journeys like ABZÛ and The Pathless, Giant Squid returns with Sword of the Sea! Surf across magnificent waves of sand and glistening waters on an epic quest to restore a lost ocean.

name: ShrimpFriedRice Games
description: Sashimi Slayer is an alternative controller rhythm arcade game developed by 4 UC Davis students and alumni. Use a martial arts sword as a controller to parry the kraken's tentacles, then tilt the sword and withdraw the blade from the sheath on the beat to slice your enemies into sushi! Previously exhibited at alt.ctrl.GDC 2025, GDC 2026, PAX West.

name: DiveWhaleCo
description: The Lampkeeper is a cozy adventure game developed at DiveWhale Co. by Jared Nussbaum, with music by Justin Carothers, Mieke, and Jacob Kinsworthy. You play as a Lampkeeper, a construct of pure luminescence, created to push back the steadfast dark of the afterlife.

name: Cody Childress
description: From animator and developer on Uncharted 4, Horizon: Zero Dawn, Death Stranding, The Last of Us Part II, and Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart — comes Project Beast, a creature-collecting RPG for PC currently in early development. Imagine the heart of Pokemon meets the visual polish of Sony's finest.
